jobs.name: An Taghan
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated fantasy house warrior. Reference 1 determines ONLY the approved matte painted figure style, NEVER its plate armour, helmet, blue colours, griffin or outer haze. Reference 2 is the specific house emblem: use its palette and one or two sensible badges, NOT a floating emblem behind the person.

Große gut lesbare Rüstungs-, Stoff- und Werkzeugformen; weiche dünne gemalte Konturen und behutsame dunklere Formtrennungen. DESIGN: Sturdy Albic male hill warrior with a short dark beard, battered rounded iron spangenhelm with cheek guards, short mail hauberk, practical russet leather shoulder panels and slate-green and bone-white tartan kilt.
